name: CyCognito — Assets
description: Pull discovered external assets from CyCognito EASM platform

instance_url_field.label: API Base URL
instance_url_field.help: Use https://api.us-platform.cycognito.com for US region, or your region-specific URL

steps.instruction: Log into the CyCognito platform at https://platform.cycognito.com
Navigate to Settings > Integrations > API Keys
Click 'Create API Key' and copy the generated key

validation_request.error_message: Authentication failed. Verify your API key and base URL.

transform.expr: {'ip': record.get('ip', ''), 'hostname': record.get('domain', ''), 'fqdn': record.get('domain', ''), 'display_name': record.get('domain') or record.get('ip', '')}

{'asset_type': record.get('type', ''), 'hosting_type': record.get('hosting_type', ''), 'security_grade': record.get('security_grade', ''), 'issues_count': record.get('issues_count', 0), 'severe_issues': record.get('severe_issues', 0), 'alive': record.get('alive', False), 'discoverability': record.get('discoverability', ''), 'investigation_status': record.get('investigation_status', ''), 'organizations': record.get('organizations', []), 'locations': record.get('locations', []), 'open_ports': record.get('open_ports', []), 'sub_domains': record.get('sub_domains', [])}

asset_type.description: Asset type to pull: ip, domain, cert, webapp, or iprange
